content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, so the payer path is exhausted; the authorization denial does not establish a contractual patient share despite the remaining deductible and coinsurance. With no secondary payer and no collectible patient liability, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
